描述_EN: lacquer workers quickly realised the decorative potential of the material and sometimes painted patterns on the lacquered surface. lacquer is a waterproof varnish made from the sap of the tree rhus vernicifera. this dish is an example of the usually plain lacquered wares produced in china during the sophisticated song dynasty (960-1279). the chinese began to use it to provide a protective coating for wooden and bamboo bowls at least 3000 years ago.
描述_ZN: 漆器工人很快意识到了这种材料的装饰潜力，有时会在漆器表面绘制图案。 漆是一种防水的清漆，是由树的汁液制成的，它是由Rhus vernicifera制成的。 这个盘子是在复杂的宋代（960-1279）期间在中国生产的通常是普通漆器的例子。 中国人至少在3000年前就开始用它来为木碗和竹碗提供保护层。
